title: EIV - Server Compatibility
description: Allows you to see crafting recipes on non-modded servers (paper) with EIV installed on the client
body:
# EIV Server Compatability You want to play with a **recipe viewer** on your SMP, but the server doesn't have a modloader running (**no** forge, fabric, neoforge)?
Then this plugin is the perfect choice. Simply install it on your server and you will be able to lookup recipes with EIV installed on the client. ![Crafting Recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/127dc751f7bf03aa6e81b3015c0f234538ed7d1d.png)
Checkout the [project page](https://modrinth.com/mod/eiv) of EIV for more information on how to use the mod. ## Currently supported server software - _Paper (and any forks)_
## Builtin recipe support for... - **_Shaped Crafting_** - **_Shapeless Crafting_** - **_Smelting_** - **_Blasting_** - **_Smoking_** - **_Stonecutting_** - **_Smithing_** - **_Brewing_** - **_Burning_** ## API _API documentation is coming soon on github._
